{{Youmay|the in-universe [[Book/Legends|book]]|the [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|real-world reference book]]}}
'''''The Essential Guide to Alien Species''''' was a [[Book/Legends|book]] [[Writing/Legends|written]] by a [[Ann Margaret Lewis|ghost writer]] based on data collected by the [[Shi'ido]] [[Sentientologist|anthropologist]] [[Mammon Hoole]]. The work was published during the rule of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] by a [[Unidentified publisher|publisher]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TEGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hoole's book is the in-universe equivalent to the real-world book [[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']], which was written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] and published by [[Del Rey]] in [[2001]].<ref name="TEGAS" />
